    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter
    Counts failures in memory, over a sliding window: at most maxFailuresPerAccount for one key from one address, and maxFailuresPerAddress from one address across every key.
    Methods in com.egradx.auth.security that return EgradxAttemptLimiter
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    static EgradxAttemptLimiter
    EgradxAttemptLimiter.none()
    Limits nothing — for code that constructs services by hand, and for turning limiting off.

    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    EgradxRedisAttemptLimiter
    Counts wrong passwords in Redis, so every instance counts together: the same sliding window, limits and waits as EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter, kept in two sorted sets per guess (contracts/redis).
